faq.q: Will using AI violate MARA Code of Conduct?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Data screening and draft preparation can be automated, but all submissions to Immigration must be signed off by you personally—that's our compliance floor.

faq.q: Which visa categories do you cover?
faq.a: Skilled migration, investment, family reunion, and other major types—constantly updated. Custom categories available.
Monthly subscription (with team discounts) or per-project pricing. Free during beta; pricing model adjusts based on feedback.
